reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight-Up Serum 30mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: Has a gel like consistency and is super thin. Doesn't irritate my retinol routine and could see visible difference on my pores. Would 100% repurchase!
reviews.zh: 質地似 gel，非常薄。唔會同我嘅 A 醇護膚程序起衝突，而且可以見到毛孔有明顯改善。一定會回購！

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight-Up Serum 30mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: Omg this stuff has become the star of my morning routine. I've always felt like I had huge pores and this is a miracle worker. Only used a few times and this with the matching cream has made my glass skin dreams a reality. Like glowing!
reviews.zh: 天啊，呢支嘢已經成為我晨間護膚嘅主角。我一直覺得自己毛孔好大，佢簡直係奇蹟救星。淨係用咗幾次，配合佢嘅面霜，已經令我想擁有玻璃肌嘅夢想成真。即係會發光嗰種！

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight-Up Serum 30mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: I bought it for the first time because I was concerned about my pores in the summer. Since there is no irritation, I don't think the effect will come out right away. But the feeling of use isn't bad, so I'll keep using it!
reviews.zh: 因為擔心夏天毛孔嘅問題所以第一次買嚟試。由於用落無刺激，所以估唔到即時見效。但使用感覺唔差，所以會繼續用落去！

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight-Up Serum 30mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: Can I tell you how much I love this serum? Like, after using ilso sebum softening, I use Anua's azelaic acid serum to calm the redness and then use this to help close my open pores! I've noticed that my pores are cleaner longer and tighter looking.
reviews.zh: 可唔可以同你講我有幾鍾意呢支精華？用完 ilso 嘅軟化皮脂產品之後，我會用 Anua 嘅壬二酸精華去舒緩泛紅，再搽呢支去幫助收毛孔！我留意到毛孔乾淨咗同埋睇落緊緻咗，效果維持得更耐。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight-Up Serum 30mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: I really love this product. The quality is consistently great, and it has become one of my favorites. I'm already restocking because it's so useful, and I will definitely purchase it again in the future
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢件產品。質素一直都好穩定，已經成為我最愛嘅產品之一。因為真係好實用所以已經補貨，未來一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight-Up Serum 30mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: I’m combination skin so it’s hard to find serum that works on my both dry part and oily part of my face. This one is very light and moisturizing! It really cools my face down and helps with makeup after too. I usually layer twice on my face where i feel dry.
reviews.zh: 我係混合性肌膚，好難搵到一款精華可以同時照顧到我面嘅乾位同油位。呢支質地好輕而且好保濕！真係可以幫我面部降溫，之後上妝都更加貼。我通常會喺覺得乾嘅位置搽兩層。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight-Up Serum 30mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: I"m not so sure of its claims. I've been using this serum for about a month on my T-Zone but can't say that it has improved the appearance of my pores yet. It might be a little too premature to assume it would show any improvements though. I still have 3 more bottles of these so hopefully it would deliver the promise. On the other hand, I don't think it has any smells or has caused any irritations. The bottle is heavy and that's my only complaint. I wish OY would give you more time to update the reviews much later like 6 months time frame after the purchase so i can really see/feel the difference if any.
reviews.zh: 我對佢嘅功效唔太確定。喺 T 區用咗大約一個月，但暫時仲未見到毛孔有明顯改善。當然而家就斷定有冇效可能言之尚早。我仲有 3 支未開，希望可以見到佢承諾嘅效果。另一方面，我覺得佢冇咩味道，亦都冇引起刺激。樽身比較重，呢個係唯一嘅投訴。希望 OY 可以畀更長嘅時間去更新評價，例如購買後 6 個月，等我可以真正睇到或者感覺到有冇分別。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Tight-Up Serum 30mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text:
Lightweight Texture (4/5):
Dispensing the serum onto my fingertips, I was impressed by its lightweight and silky texture. It felt smooth and non-greasy, absorbing quickly into my skin without any residue. The serum had a pleasant herbal scent that was not overpowering.

Pore-Tightening Effects (3.5/5):
The standout feature of this serum was its ability to tighten and refine pores. With regular use, I noticed that my pores appeared smaller and less noticeable, giving my skin a smoother and more even texture. The serum helped to mattify my T-zone without drying out other areas of my face.

Balancing Formula (4/5):
I appreciated the serum's balancing formula, which helped to control excess oil and minimize shine. It effectively regulated sebum production, reducing the appearance of blackheads and blemishes. The serum left my skin feeling balanced and refreshed, making it an essential step in my daily skincare routine.
reviews.zh:
輕盈質地 (4/5)：
將精華擠喺指尖上，佢輕盈絲滑嘅質地令我印象深刻。觸感柔滑唔油膩，可以好快被皮膚吸收，冇殘留感。精華帶有淡淡嘅草本香味，唔會太搶。

收毛孔效果 (3.5/5)：
呢支精華最突出嘅係佢收毛孔同細緻肌膚嘅能力。持續使用之後，我留意到毛孔睇落細咗冇咁明顯，膚質變得更平滑更均勻。精華可以幫 T 區做到霧面效果，但又唔會抽乾面其他位置嘅水分。

平衡配方 (4/5)：
我好欣賞呢支精華嘅平衡配方，可以控制多餘油脂、減少油光。佢有效調節皮脂分泌，減低黑頭同痘痘嘅出現。用完之後皮膚感覺平衡又清爽，已經成為我日常護膚嘅必備步驟。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
